name: Thirty Years' War
description: Europe's most destructive religious-political war, fought largely on German soil where perhaps a third of the population died. Ended at Westphalia with the state system that still frames international relations.

name: Seven Years' War
description: Arguably the first world war, fought in Europe, North America, the Caribbean, West Africa, and India. Britain emerged the dominant colonial and naval power — with debts whose taxation of America sparked revolution.
